entities.summary: Professor Akiko Kobayashi is a Japanese chemist born in Tokyo. She is the designer and creator of Ni(tmdt)2, the world's first single-component molecular metal. Akiko Kobayashi was a scientists & inventors from Tokyo Prefecture (b. 1943, Tokyo Prefecture). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
